name: SERGDATA Workbench optional AI-Knowledge controls
scope: Adds a menu entry and a small dialog for checking the configured AI-Knowledge path and launching existing kb.py indexer for one file/folder.
safety: Does not modify .env, .workbench, databases, credentials, Git metadata, or AI-Knowledge source files.
Indexing accepts only existing files/folders within configured KB_CWD.
Uses existing kb.py --no-release-sync --path; MCP connection and agent tool contracts remain unchanged.
